missions.title: "All The Lights In The Sky Are Stars"
missions.description: Before saving the world, you must witness "Lunasia's death".

missions.title: "New World"
missions.description: "You" will prepare thousands, tens of thousands of paths, and "I" will only ever choose the most lonely and marvellous of them.

missions.title: "Past The Infinite Darkness"
missions.description: "A single life is too short; you only had enough time to become a brave man."

missions.title: "Achievement Point"
missions.description: The acid rain cloud called "Paradeus" always accumulates above sewage.

missions.title: "The Real Folk Blues, Part II"
missions.description: A tactical victory cannot make up for a strategic misstep.

missions.title: "The Vision of Youth"
missions.description: At times, lies are defeated by a little bit of courage—May your courage shine on forever.

missions.title: "Coming of the Promised Day"
missions.description: Old enemies, reunited at the very end.

missions.title: "My Very Best Friend"
missions.description: "Ideals are a truly terrifying double-edged sword."

missions.title: "Eclipse"
missions.description: That is the kind of defeat you hate most.

missions.title: “Hellfire”
missions.description: "Because... You are William, and our score will never, ever be settled."

missions.title: "Awakening"
missions.description: That promise drifted in the wind and landed in the heart, but unfortunately it could not sprout the flower of fulfilment.

missions.title: "Initialize"
missions.description: A misstep after a long separation is like sweet, poisoned wine—It tastes good, but ultimately, it brings only death.

missions.title: "From The New World"
missions.description: "Your sister" will protect you again and again, forever and ever...

missions.title: "Seeing A Dream Through to the End"
missions.description: Even a false "you" is still part of "us".

missions.title: "Journey's End"
missions.description: I've waited a long time for this day.

missions.title: "Perfect World"
missions.description: Perhaps we will live brand new lives, perhaps we will be happier, but the one thing nobody can deny is this—everyone is looking forward to the day we can reunite with you...
